explanation: Searched Mathlib for a bound of the form `(I.under R).height ≤ I.height` (or with `comap`) under `Algebra.HasGoingDown`. Checked Mathlib/RingTheory/Ideal/GoingDown.lean: it has `Ideal.exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingDown` but no height lemma. Checked Ideal/Height.lean: it has `RingEquiv.height_comap` and `IsLocalization.height_under`, which only cover ring equivalences and localizations. Checked KrullsHeightTheorem.lean: `Ideal.height_le_height_add_of_liesOver` and `Ideal.height_eq_height_add_of_liesOver_of_hasGoingDown` need `S` Noetherian and prime ideals with `LiesOver`, so they don't apply to the theorem's setting as it is. Also grepped for lemma names containing height/primeHeight together with comap/under/GoingDown, and for statements of the form `... .height ≤ ... .height`. Nothing matched. The library proves the result from `Ideal.exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingDown` and `Ideal.height_eq_inf_minimalPrimes`, which is more than routine glue.
